A Client Script executes before a record is loaded and a Business Rule executes after a record is updated

questions.explanation: A Client Script executes in the user's browser (client side), while a Business Rule executes on the ServiceNow server (server side).

questions.stem: What are benefits of assigning work tasks to a group, rather than to an individual? (Choose four.)

options.text: Group members can choose their tasks from My Groups Work
Groups can assign tasks to users based on on-call schedules
Site support members can pick tasks, based on Location
Groups can assign tasks to users based on skills
Group members can avoid tasks, which are nearing SLA breach
Groups can assign tasks to users based on availability

questions.explanation: Benefits of group assignment include: members choose tasks from My Groups Work (A), on-call schedule routing (B), skills-based routing (D), availability (F).

questions.stem: What ServiceNow feature allows you to include data from a secondary related table on a report?
questions.explanation: Dot-walking allows a report to include data from a secondary related table by traversing reference fields using dot notation (e.g., assigned_to.department).

questions.stem: What attributes can you manage, using System Properties > Basic Configuration UI16? (Choose five.)
questions.explanation: Configurable attributes include: browser tab title (A), module text color (B), base theme (D), header background color (G), banner image (H).

questions.stem: Which field (or fields) is used as a unique key during imports?
questions.explanation: Coalesce Fields act as unique keys during imports. When a coalesce field value matches an existing record, that record is updated rather than duplicated.

questions.stem: You are asked to create an option in the Service Catalog, which will allow a user to click Get Help and describe the issue they are having. These forms should create incident records, which are automatically routed to the Service Desk. Which method would you use?
questions.explanation: A Record Producer is used to create records in any table (like incidents) from the Service Catalog, with automatic routing via workflow.

questions.stem: What is the result of the order in which access controls are evaluated?

options.text: Ensures user has access to the fields in a table, before considering their access to the table
Ensures user can get to work as quickly as possible
Ensures user has access to the application, before evaluating access to a module within the application
Ensures user has access to a table, before evaluating access to a field in the table

questions.explanation: Access controls are evaluated table-level first, then field-level. A user must have table access before field-level access is evaluated.

questions.stem: Which tool graphically displays an infrastructure view for a configuration item (CI) and its relationship with other CIs?
questions.explanation: The Dependency View graphically displays an infrastructure view for a CI and its relationships with other CIs, showing upstream and downstream dependencies.

questions.stem: What are examples of Core tables in the ServiceNow platform?
questions.explanation: Core platform tables include User [sys_user], Task [task], and Incident [incident]. These are foundational tables used across ServiceNow.

questions.stem: Which tab on the knowledge base record, would you use to identify the sets of users who are able to read articles in that knowledge base?
questions.explanation: The Can Read tab on the knowledge base record is used to identify the sets of users who are able to read articles in that knowledge base.

questions.stem: What are the main components of the Form Design interface? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: The main components of the Form Design interface are: Page Header (B) for navigation, Field Navigator (C) for available fields, and Form Layout (E) for arrangement.

questions.stem: What is used to determine user access to knowledge bases or a knowledge article?
questions.explanation: User Criteria determines which users can access a knowledge base or knowledge article, based on attributes like role, group, or company.

questions.stem: What are the three key tables in an enterprise CMDB? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: The three key tables in an enterprise CMDB are: cmdb (A, base CI table), cmdb_rel_ci (C, CI relationships), and cmdb_ci (F, configuration items).

questions.stem: What is the best practice related to using the Default Update Set for moving customizations between instances?

options.text: Merge Default update sets before moving between instances
Submit Default update set to application repository
You should not use the Default Update sets for moving between instances
Keep Default update set to maximum of 20 records, for troubleshooting purposes

questions.explanation: The Default Update Set should not be used for moving customizations between instances—always create named update sets for migrations.

questions.stem: On what part of the ServiceNow instance, would you find the option to Impersonate User?
questions.explanation: The Impersonate User option is found in the Banner at the top of the page, accessible by clicking the user profile icon or avatar menu.

questions.stem: Which application is used primarily to load data into ServiceNow?
questions.explanation: The System Import Sets application is the primary tool used to load data into ServiceNow from external sources.

questions.stem: If a knowledge base has no access details specified, what users are able to read articles in that knowledge base?

options.text: Any user with an article's permalink

questions.explanation: If a knowledge base has no user criteria (access details) specified, any active user can read articles in that knowledge base by default.

questions.stem: How would you define an Access Control, to allow a user with itil role to have permission to create incident records?

options.text: Name: incident.None; Operation: create; Role: itil
Name: incident.Any; Operation: write; Permission: itil
Name: incident:*; Permission: write; Role: itil
Name: incident.None; Permission: create; Role: itil

questions.explanation: To allow itil role to create incidents: Name=incident.None (table-level), Operation=create, Role=itil. incident.None applies to the whole table for creates.

questions.stem: What Service Catalog feature do you use to organize items into logical groups?
questions.explanation: Categories are used to organize service catalog items into logical groups, making it easier for users to browse and find relevant items.

questions.stem: When creating a new notification, what must you define? (Choose three.)

options.text: Settings for handing inactive user accounts
Under what conditions is the notification sent
What the content of the notification

questions.explanation: When creating a new notification you must define: the conditions under which it is sent (C), who receives it (D), and the content of the notification (E).

questions.stem: The ServiceNow platform supports a wide variety of plug-and-play applications. You can choose from the included workflows of build your own workflow: Which of these workflows are included in the platform? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: ServiceNow includes three built-in workflow categories: Customer Workflows (B), Employee Workflows (E), and IT Workflows (F) as part of the Now Platform.

questions.stem: An IT manager is responsible for the Network and Hardware assignment groups, each group contains 5 team members. These team members are working on many tasks, but the manager cannot see any tasks on the Service Desk > My Groups Work list. What could explain this?

options.text: The Assignment Group manager field is empty.
The manager does not have the itil role.
The manager is not a member of the Service Desk group.
The manager is not a member of the Network and Hardware groups.

questions.explanation: The My Groups Work list shows tasks for groups the user is a MEMBER of—not just manages. A manager must also be a member to see those tasks.

questions.stem: You have been asked to configure a form so an employee could order tablet and select the standard accessory options to purchase with it. These standard options are: carrying case, screen cleaner, tablet stand, and screen protector. What approach would you take? (Choose three.)

options.text: Create Catalog Item for the Tablet, and add a variable set to the form, for the accessory options.
Create a Record producer, and on the form, add a check box variable for each accessory option.
On Shopping Cart configuration, select option lo show the Add Accessories button.
Create one Catalog item for each: tablet, carrying case, screen cleaner, tablet stand, and screen protector.
Create Catalog Item for the tablet, and on the form, add a check box variable for each accessory option.

questions.explanation: For a tablet with accessory options: create catalog item for the tablet with a variable set (A), separate items for each accessory (D), and check box variables (E).

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow utility provides a modern interactive graphical interface to visualize configuration items and their relationships?
questions.explanation: Dependency Views provides a modern interactive graphical interface built on D3 and Angular technology to visualize CIs and their relationships.

questions.stem: What is the definition of a group?

options.text: A collection of subject matter experts

questions.explanation: A Group is defined as a collection of users who share a common purpose, used for task assignment, notifications, and access control.

questions.stem: On the Reports page, what sections allow you to see which reports are visible to different audiences? (Choose four.)
questions.explanation: The Reports page sections that show visibility by audience are: Group (A), My reports (C), Global (E), and All (F).

questions.stem: On a filter condition, there is an element, which is based on the table, the user access rights, and columns on the table. What is this element called?
questions.explanation: The Field element in a filter condition is based on the table, the user's access rights, and available columns—it defines what you are filtering on.

questions.stem: You have been asked to create a way for users to order a new iPhone, but only if they get two levels of approval. The approvers and users should be automatically notified at each approval level. What feature would you use to manage the approvals and notifications?
questions.explanation: Use Flows in Flow Designer to manage multi-level approvals and automated notifications. Flows can trigger approval steps and notify approvers at each level.

questions.stem: Groups are stored in what table?
questions.explanation: Group records are stored in the Group [sys_user_group] table. The table name sys_user_group is the standard for ServiceNow user groups.

questions.stem: When managing tags, you can adjust who is able to see it. What are the visibility options? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: When managing tags, three visibility options are available: Me (B, only you), Groups and Users (A, specific people), and Everyone (D, all users).

questions.stem: What module enables an administrator to define destinations for imported data on any ServiceNow table?
questions.explanation: The Transform Map module enables administrators to define destination field mappings for imported data on any ServiceNow target table.

questions.stem: On the Form header, which icon do you use to access form templates?
questions.explanation: Click the More Options (...) icon on the form header to access form templates, which pre-populate form fields with commonly used values.

questions.stem: When using the Data Pill Picker, use which keys to dot-walk to fields in other tables?
questions.explanation: Use the arrow keys in the Data Pill Picker to dot-walk through reference fields to access data from related tables.

questions.stem: In what order are Access Controls evaluated?

options.text: Field-level - most specific to most general; then Table-level - most specific to most general
Field-level - most general to most specific; then Row-level - most specific to most general
Table-level - most specific to most general; then Field-level - most specific to most general
Table-level - most specific to most general, then Row-level - most specific to most general

questions.explanation: Access controls are evaluated Table-level first (most specific to most general), then Field-level (most specific to most general).

questions.stem: What instance resource allows you to access guided tours, information about actions, and instructions on how to use inputs and outputs in your flow?
questions.explanation: The Help Panel (question mark icon) in Flow Designer provides guided tours, information about actions, and instructions on inputs and outputs.

questions.stem: The Report Designer contains different sections for configuring your report. Which section is used to specify grouping and calculations to be run against the data?
questions.explanation: The Configure section of the Report Designer is used to specify grouping criteria and calculations (aggregations) to run against the report data.

questions.stem: What icon do you use to change the icon and color on a Favorite?
questions.explanation: To change the icon and color of a Favorite item in the application navigator, click the Pencil (edit) icon next to the favorite.

questions.stem: You have heard about a new application released by ServiceNow. You want to try it out, to see if it might be useful for your company's ServiceNow implementation. What would be the best way to get hands-on experience with the new application?

options.text: Search the wiki for the sales demo request form
Check the latest release notes at docs servicenow.com
Activate the application plug in, on your personal dev instance
Activate the application plug in, on your company's production instance.

questions.explanation: To safely test a new ServiceNow application, activate the plugin on your personal developer instance before considering production use.

questions.stem: When looking at a long list of records, you want to quickly filter, to show only those which have Category of Hardware. How might you do that?

options.text: On the Category column header, right click and select Show > Hardware
Right click on magnifier, type Hardware and click enter
On the list, locate and right click on the value Hardware, select Show Matching
On Breadcrumb, click > icon, type Hardware and click enter
Click Funnel icon, type Hardware and click enter

questions.explanation: To quickly filter a list to show only matching records, right-click on the value you want to filter by (e.g., Hardware) and select Show Matching.

questions.stem: When looking at a long list of records, you want to quickly filter, to show only those which have Short Description containing email. How might you do that?

options.text: Click List Magnifier to expand column search, on Short Description, type email, click enter
On Search box, select text, type email, click enter
Click List Magnifier to expand column search, on Short Description, type *email, click enter
Click List Magnifier to expand column search, on Short Description, type %email, click enter

questions.explanation: In the list magnifier column search, prefix the search term with * (e.g., *email) to find records where the field contains the search string anywhere.

questions.stem: When importing spreadsheet data into ServiceNow, what is the first step in the process?
questions.explanation: The first step when importing spreadsheet data into ServiceNow is Load Data—this imports the file and populates the import set staging table.

questions.stem: Tables may be set up with Many to Many relationships. What is a classic example of a scenario where the tables would have many to many relationships?

options.text: Vendors can sell multiple products; and products can be sold by multiple vendors.
A Task can trigger many Workflows; and a Workflow can trigger many Tasks.
Requests can contain many Items; and Items can be any item from the catalog.
A Configuration Item can belong to multiple Classes, and Classes can contain multiple Configuration Items.

questions.explanation: A classic Many-to-Many example: vendors can sell multiple products, and products can be sold by multiple vendors—a bidirectional relationship.

questions.stem: What section on a task record would you use to see the most recent update made to a record?
questions.explanation: The Activity section on a task record shows the most recent updates, including work notes, comments, and field changes made to the record.

questions.stem: The Employee On-boarding team has asked for a way for managers to order computers, monitors, business cards, and cell phones for new employees. How would you proceed to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: An Order Guide bundles multiple catalog items into a single request. It is ideal for scenarios like new employee onboarding with multiple items.

questions.stem: On the CI Dependency View, what enables you to trace from an infrastructure item, like a Server, to the Services that are dependent on that Server?
questions.explanation: Relationships defined between CIs in the CMDB enable Dependency View to trace from an infrastructure item (e.g., Server) to the services that depend on it.

questions.stem: From a related list, what would a user click to personalize the layout of the columns?
questions.explanation: Click the Gear icon on a related list to personalize the column layout, including adding, removing, or reordering columns.

questions.stem: What is the language used for scripting in ServiceNow?
questions.explanation: JavaScript is the scripting language used throughout ServiceNow, including business rules, client scripts, script includes, and UI actions.

questions.stem: What are examples of UI Actions, relating to Lists? (Choose four.)
questions.explanation: UI Actions for lists include: List Links (A), List Choices (B), List Buttons (C), and List Context Menu (E). These are the four list-specific UI Action types.

questions.stem:
A Service Catalog project will involve building 80 catalog items. For each of the catalog items, the following fields will be mandatory on the forms:
• Requested for
• Requested by
• Approving manager
• Delivery instructions

All of the other variables will be specific to the individual catalog item. What features would you use when designing the catalog item form?

options.text: Create a Variable Set Template, then apply to all of the catalog items.
Create one Variable Set for the four variables, then add that variable set to each of the 80 catalog items.
Create a Record Producer that contains the four fields; then add to the record producer related list on the Catalog Items.
Create a Flow Designer Action, with Variable Set Data Pill, then apply flow to all of the 80 catalog items.
Create an Order Guide, which includes all variables; then copy and hide variables as needed.

questions.explanation: Create one Variable Set containing the four common variables, then add that variable set to each of the 80 catalog items to avoid duplication.

questions.stem: A task worker asks how they can monitor any updates occurring to records assigned to him, like responses from customers. What do you suggest?

options.text: On My Work list, select the Activity Stream icon to show a frame with live updates
Click on the eyeglass icon to expand the Monitor frame
Open an Agent workspace tab for each record he wants to monitor
Select Service Desk > My Work Dashboard

questions.explanation: On the My Work list, click the Activity Stream icon next to a record to open a live-updating frame showing the latest comments and changes for that record.

questions.stem: What access does a user need to be able to import articles to a knowledge base?
questions.explanation: To import articles to a knowledge base, a user must have Can Contribute access (contribute permission) to that knowledge base.

questions.stem: When importing data from a spreadsheet, which step defines where the incoming data columns will be written in the receiving table?
questions.explanation: Create Transform Map is the step that defines where incoming data columns will be written in the receiving table by mapping source fields to target fields.

questions.stem: To apply a UI Policy to all views, which field should be set to true in its definition record?
questions.explanation: Setting the Global field to true on a UI Policy definition applies that policy to all form views, not just the default view.

questions.stem: What are the steps for importing data using an import set?

options.text: Select source file; Run automap; Transform data; Clean up target table
Identity source; Import transform map; Run transformer, Verify import
Setup LDAP; Test map; Create update set; Run import; Apply update set
Load the data; Create transform map; Transform data; Clean up import table

questions.explanation: The four steps for importing data using an import set are: Load the data, Create transform map, Transform data, then Clean up the import table.

questions.stem: Which type of scripts run in the browser?
questions.explanation: UI Policies and Client Scripts run in the user's browser (client side). Business Rules and Script Includes run on the ServiceNow server.

questions.stem: Which modules can you use to create a new table? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: New tables can be created using the Tables module (C) or the Tables & Columns module (D), both found under System Definition in the navigator.

questions.stem: Which one of the following describes the primary operations performed against tables in the ServiceNow platform?
questions.explanation: The four primary operations on ServiceNow tables are Create (insert a record), Read (query records), Write (update records), and Delete (remove records).

questions.stem: How is a user defined in ServiceNow?

options.text: A user is a record stored in the Profile [sys_user_profile] table
A user is a record stored in the User [sys_user] table
A user is a record stored in the User Preference [sys_user_preference] table
A user is a field in the LDAP integration

questions.explanation: A user is defined as a record stored in the User [sys_user] table. Each row represents one user account with their profile and attributes.

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow utility gives a Service Desk agent the ability to trace from a Service having an issue, to see which CIs supporting that service have active issues?
questions.explanation: The CI Dependency View enables service desk agents to trace from a service experiencing issues to the specific CIs supporting that service.

questions.stem: Which feature enables business process owners to organize Flow Designer content into unified and digitized cross-enterprise processes via a digitized task board interface?
questions.explanation: Process Automation Designer enables business process owners to organize Flow Designer content into unified cross-enterprise processes via a task board.

questions.stem: An IT user calls the service desk because they need to work on task records. All they can see is Self Service on their homepage when they login to the ServiceNow instance. What issue could explain this? (Choose two.)

options.text: Their user account does not have itil role
Their user account was not approved by their manager
Their user account is not logged in properly
Their user account failed LDAP authentication
Their user account does not belong to any groups, which contain the itil role

questions.explanation: If a user sees only Self Service, they likely lack the itil role (A) or are not a member of any group that has the itil role assigned (E).

questions.stem: On a related list, which buttons are commonly used for managing the records on the list? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: The commonly available buttons on a related list for managing records are: Add (A) to link existing records, Edit (B) to modify, and New (E) to create.

questions.stem:
A customer requests the following data quality measures be added:
• Incident numbers should be read only, on all lists and forms, for all users.
• Short Description field should be mandatory, on all records, across all applications, on Insert.

Which type of policy would you use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: Data Policy applies read-only and mandatory rules across all lists, forms, and users—including server-side enforcement for all interfaces.

questions.stem: On what part of the ServiceNow instance, would you find the option to access applications, like Incident Management?
questions.explanation: The Application Navigator is the left-side navigation panel used to access applications and modules like Incident Management, CMDB, and more.

questions.stem: What catalog tool would you use to create a catalog item or record producer?
questions.explanation: Catalog Builder module (All > Service Catalog > Catalog Builder) provides a visual guided experience for creating and editing catalog items.

questions.stem: On a form, which type of field has this icon which can be clicked, to see a preview of the associated record?
questions.explanation: Reference field type stores a pointer to a record in another table and displays a value from that referenced record.

questions.stem: While on an Incident record, how would you add a Tag for "Special Handling" to the record?

options.text: Click on the Context menu, select Add Tag, type Special Handling, press enter
Click on the More options (...) icon, click Add Tag, type Special Handling, press enter
On the Tag field, select Special Handling from the choice list
On the Special Handling field, check the box

questions.explanation: A=Meeting Invitation, B=Email, E=SMS. These are the primary channels for alerting users of events.

questions.stem: What are the steps to apply an update set retrieved from another instance?

options.text: Load the Update Set > Import the Update Set > Install
Verity Update Set is Complete, Retrieve, Preview, Commit
Verify Update Set is Complete, Test Connection, Apply
Import the Update Set > Verify the Update Set is complete > Link the Update Set > Publish

questions.explanation: Verify it is Complete > Retrieve (from remote instance) > Preview (check conflicts) > Commit (apply changes).

questions.stem: After finishing your work on High Security Settings, what is a possible way to return to normal admin security levels?

options.text: Use System Administration > Normal Security module

questions.explanation: After High Security Settings work, log out and back in to return to normal admin security level without the elevated security_admin role.

questions.stem: Which feature can be used to give users the choice to easily populate the most-used fields for a specific table?
questions.explanation: Templates pre-populate the most-used fields for a table, giving users a quick way to create records with standard field values.

questions.stem: What protects applications by restricting access to data in another application, in the same instance?
questions.explanation: Application Scope protects applications by identifying and restricting access to application files/data from other apps in same instance.

questions.stem: Which module in the Service Catalog application is used to create a new catalog item?
questions.explanation: Maintain Items module in Service Catalog application (Service Catalog > Maintain Items) is used to create and manage catalog items.

questions.stem: What helps to define the structure of a catalog item form that is displayed to the customer?
questions.explanation: Variables define the structure of a catalog item form - each variable captures specific customer input displayed when ordering.

questions.stem: Which displays the list of activities, or history, on a form?
questions.explanation: Activity Formatter (a Formatter type) displays the list of activities and history on a task form, showing all updates chronologically.

questions.stem: Where should an administrator navigate to add the "Save" button in the form header?

options.text: All > System Properties > UI Action Settings

questions.explanation: Navigate to All > System Properties > UI Properties to enable the property that adds the Save button to the form header.

questions.stem: What are the options that can be set to determine when a Business Rule executes? (Choose four.)
questions.explanation: A=Async (background), D=Display (before form loads), E=After (post-DB save), F=Before (pre-DB operation).

questions.stem: Which access control rule applies to every field in the incident table?
questions.explanation: incident.* ACL applies to every field in the incident table - the wildcard (*) as object name means all fields are covered by this rule.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of an application scope?

options.text: Scope determines which parts of an application are available for use by other applications In ServiceNow
Scope prevents applications from changing their own tables and business logic
Scope determines the functionality of core services in the platform
Scope determines all applications access each other's tables and business logic

questions.explanation: Application scope determines which parts of an application (tables, scripts, UI) are available for use by other applications in the instance.

questions.stem: On a Catalog Task record, how would an administrator change the priority choice options?

options.text: In the Context menu of the form, select Configure Options
Right-click the Priority Label > select Configure Lists
Right-click the Priority Label > select Configure Choices
Open the Data Dictionary > select Values

questions.explanation: Right-click the Priority Label on the Catalog Task form > Configure Choices to add, edit, or remove priority dropdown options.

questions.stem: Which sequence of actions applies an update set to an instance?
questions.explanation: Retrieve (download from remote) > Preview (check for conflicts) > Commit (apply to current instance).

questions.stem:
A customer asks you to make the following updates to a form:

1. When Caller field is populated, automatically look up caller location and load it in the Location field.
2. Add notice at the top of the page when the record is submitted.

What type of script would you use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: onChange auto-populates Location from Caller field; onSubmit displays notice when form is submitted.

questions.stem: Where do Ul Policies run?
questions.explanation: UI Policies execute client-side in the browser, dynamically controlling field properties like mandatory, visible, and read-only.

questions.stem:
You are creating a catalog item for ordering a new desktop computer. The computers have these options:


Color: Black or Silver -

RAM: 32 MB or 64MB -

Keyboard: Standard or Ergonomic -

Monitor: 24 inch or 32 inch -

How would you add these options to the catalog item form?
questions.explanation: Add variables to catalog item to present options (Color, RAM, Keyboard, Monitor) as choice fields on the catalog item ordering form.

questions.stem: Which form element displays the list of activities, or history, on a task form?
questions.explanation: Activity Formatter is the form element that displays the list of activities and history (comments, work notes, changes) on a task form.

questions.stem: Which actions can you take to open the Context Menu on a list, form, or column? (Choose two.)

options.text: Select the Context Menu related link
Double-click on the list form or column heading
Right-click on the list, form or column heading

questions.explanation: C=Right-click on the list, form, or column heading; E=Select the Context Menu icon in the interface.

questions.stem:
Your customer wants to update a notification so it is sent to the Caller's Manager.

Which action supports this requirement?

options.text: On the 'Who will receive' tab on the Notification record add the Caller field, then dot walk to the Caller's Manager field to add it.
On the Notification record create a flow and include a notification in the flow for "All receivers".
On the 'Send to' tab on the Notification record, add the Caller field, then dot walk to the Caller’s Manager field to add it.
On the 'Send to' tab on the Notification record, set "Who will receive" to Subscribable.

questions.explanation: On the "Who will receive" tab in the Notification record, add the Caller field then dot-walk to Caller.Manager to add the manager.

questions.stem: What attributes of a field can a UI Policy Action change on a form? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: B=Mandatory (required), C=Visible/Hidden (show/hide), E=Read Only (prevent editing). Not length or format.

questions.stem: Which action enables a user to view and specify date and time formats in their instance?

options.text: Select the User menu > Preferences > Time Settings > Toggle display time zone
Ask the user to adjust the time zone on their personal computer
Use the system properties to correct the instance's time zone
Select the User menu > Preferences > Language & Region > Set date and time format and time zone
Create a UI Script to set the default timezone

questions.explanation: Use system properties to set or correct the instance time zone and date/time format settings that apply to the entire instance.

questions.stem: A manager is complaining that they can't get the data they need on a report, because the data resides in two different tables. This data is used for many different reports in their department. You have checked to see if dot-walking will meet the requirement, and it is not possible. What else might you try to help this manager?
questions.explanation: Create a Database View to join data from two tables into a virtual table, enabling reports that span multiple data sources.

questions.stem: Which storefront is a single location for accessing pre-built spokes, to quickly integrate with third party services to build and share content?
questions.explanation: ServiceNow Store is the marketplace for pre-built spokes, integrations, and apps to quickly connect ServiceNow with third-party services.

questions.stem: Which actions would you take to edit the title on an application menu? (Choose two.)

options.text: Select the Application name on the Navigator, then select the pencil icon
Select System Definitions > Application Menus then select the application
Select Configuration > Applications, then select the application
Select the form for the Application, then right-click, Configure > Form Designer

questions.explanation: C=System Definitions > Application Menus > select app; D=Configuration > Applications > select app.

questions.stem: Which components are the customer’s responsibility according to the Shared Responsibility Model? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: B=Authentication/authorization, D=Data encryption at rest. Infrastructure is ServiceNow's.

questions.stem: Which roles are required to configure the form layout using Table Builder? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: C=app_engine_admin role and D=admin role to configure form layout for application tables.

questions.stem: An Administrator wants to review all the users having privileged access to identify users that no longer need this level of access. Which Security Center feature can help fulfil this requirement?
questions.explanation: Security scanner in Security Center reviews user accounts with privileged access to identify users who no longer need elevated access.

questions.stem: Which Security Center feature helps resolve platform related security issues and misconfigurations?
questions.explanation: Security scanner in Security Center scans for and helps resolve platform security issues, misconfigurations, and policy violations.

questions.stem:
Certain cables have a prefix, like x_.

Which kind of table has a name that starts with this prefix?
questions.explanation: Tables in scoped applications have names starting with x_ prefix (e.g., x_vendor_app_tablename), distinguishing from base system tables.
